name: extract and persist the integer part of the objective
definition: isolate the truncation of the reported objective and write exactly a single number to the output file.
failure_mode: extra whitespace/newline or a float-valued value fails exact-match

name: fetch and parse HTML from a remote server
definition: Make an HTTP GET to a server and parse the returned HTML document into a traversable structure.
failure_mode: Fetch fails or HTML not parsed, so no records are collected.

name: fetch fluorescent-protein spectral data from an external spectra api
definition: Query a spectral database for excitation and emission maxima of candidate fluorescent proteins.
failure_mode: Choosing a protein with mismatched spectra fails the sequence check.

name: fetch protein sequences from an external structure-database api by identifier
definition: Given structure identifiers, retrieve the amino-acid sequences the API returns for each entry.
failure_mode: Wrong or edited sequence fails equality against the API.
